title: Four Feet on the Moon
synopsis: Star One reaches lunar orbit; the six descend in the Moon lander and settle on its four landing legs near Scout.
continuity_state: Before: The six have traveled toward the Moon and Scout already stands on the sunny near-side landing site. After: All six are safely on the lunar surface inside their landed vehicle. Return cabin remains in lunar orbit; first moonwalk waits for checks.
